description: Version 2.1 of the generalist gripper (gripper plus handles line): the 1.17 gripper plus the loop attachment. Builds on 1.17 (pebble voice-cfdf2d31: fingers same thickness along whole length) — wait for/use that version. The attachment is a small, black, flat piece that slides into the gripper and has two slots for loops (straps). No camera attachment. Closely match the reference images — key photo cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_closed.png, plus the other references under cad/reference and references/generalist. Model in OpenSCAD with every piece separable: each part its own module and its own exported STL, viewable individually and together in the live preview. Use the repo's dual-render workflow (cad/compare: three.js vision render + OpenSCAD STL, same angles, diffed; STL is truth). Versioning scheme is in AGENTS.md.

results.identified_issue: 2.1 = byte-for-byte geometry copy of v017_generalist_strap_slide (which already had lug+slide because the cfdf2d31 agent ignored the 1.17-only scope change). Copied rather than include'd so 1.x edits don't move 2.1. Folder v201 (vMNN encoding) because cad/compare/designs.py globs v[0-9][0-9][0-9] and does int(name[1:4]); publish_designs.py label 'Gen 2.1' via generations map (string value, like '11b'). Did not edit v017 (other pebble's deliverable). Unverified: photo proportions — photo block appears elongated along the finger; ours is wider outboard (37 mm) to fit a 24 mm digit gap between slots.
results.summary: Made version 2.1: the 1.17 gripper plus the black strap slide with two loop slots, in its own folder (v201_generalist_strap_loops). Every check passes.
results.detailed_description:
Version 2.1 is in Two Finger Gripper/versions/v201_generalist_strap_loops. The folder is named v201 (meaning 2.01) because the compare tool only finds folders named v plus three digits. 1.17 stays at v017.

What it is: 1.17's yellow fingers, which are 12 mm thick all the way to the point, plus the loop attachment. A yellow dovetail lug is fused to the outer edge of each finger at mid-shank. A black flat strap slide (3.5 mm thick, 28 x 37 mm) slides into that lug from the tip end and stops against the closed end. The slide has two 21 x 3.5 mm loop slots, 24 mm apart, sized for 20 mm webbing, so the loop goes down through one slot, around your digit and back up through the other. There is no camera attachment.

There are four separate parts, each with its own module and STL: right finger, left finger, right slide and left slide. The live preview shows them alone or together. All the checks pass: every STL is one watertight body, the fingers never collide from 0 to 30 degrees, only the points touch when closed, each slide fits its own finger and the dovetail holds it, and the fingers are full thickness to the point. In the web-vs-STL comparison the overlap is 95 to 100% in every view.

One thing to fix on 1.17: the 1.17 pass (voice-cfdf2d31) replied after your scope change but left the lug and slide in v017. So right now 1.17 is not gripper-only. 2.1 is a copy of that design, not a link to it, so you can send cfdf2d31 back to remove the lug and slide from v017 without changing 2.1. I didn't touch v017 because it belongs to that pebble.

Not verified: nothing has been printed. The webbing width, the 24 mm gap for your digit, the 0.2 mm fit and where the lug sits are all nominal numbers. Nothing stops the slide from sliding back out toward the tip, so it may need a detent once it is printed. Also, in the photos the black block looks longer along the finger than this one, which reaches further outboard. Tell me if you want 2.2 to match that.

summary: Model gripper version 2.1 in OpenSCAD as the 1.17 gripper plus a small, black, flat sliding loop attachment with two strap slots. Match the reference images, with each part its own module and STL, viewable alone or together.
